provenance: Rated from the 20 items exactly as the rating sheet shows them (facts, feedback, cited sources). NOT blind: Claude had seen the item-to-variant mapping earlier in the Phase 8 chat. To limit that, every score follows the written rules below and carries its reason. This is an LLM rater, not a human rating (DEC-041).

rules.correctness: 5 = every claim backed by the facts or a cited source. 4 = the main claim is backed but an extra is not, or a claim is hedged as common coaching advice. 3 = one wholly unbacked or overstated claim, or a misleading description of the measurement. 2 = two unbacked causal claims, or a statement contradicting this kick's measurements. 1 = contradicts the flagged measurement or invents a source.
rules.specificity: 5 = uses this kick's number and explains it against the reference. 4 = uses the number. 3 = names the fault only.
rules.actionability: 5 = a concrete drill the player can do and check alone. 4 = clear but loosely specified. 3 = vague, or a drill that doesn't practise the kick.

R01.reason: Lean-back matches -12.65. K-12 supports 'low'; 'accurate' is not in it. No number. Cue and slow-kick drill are clear but loose.

R02.reason: 'Your knee bend ... was 101 degrees' misdescribes an interior angle as bend (in bend terms it's about 79): a player could read it as a big bend. Power claim is backed by the cited stretch-shortening source. Leg curls build comfort but don't practise the kick.

R03.reason: -17 and its meaning are right, but 'causes your shots to rise too high and lose power' is two causal claims with no source shown. Place-kick drill is usable.

R04.reason: 17 deg back matches -16.67. The why is hedged ('coaches commonly link') but uncited. Freeze-at-contact against a wall with a shoulders-over-hips check is concrete and self-checkable.

R05.reason: Same as R04 for -19.79: correct number, hedged uncited why, concrete self-check drill.

R06.reason: Lean-away matches -17.35. K-12 supports 'low'; 'powerful' is not in it. No number. Drill clear but loose.

R07.reason: K-12 supports keeping the ball on the ground; 'reduces control' is an unbacked extra. No number. Wall passing is doable alone but practises a pass, not the instep strike.

R08.reason: Stretch -> power/speed is what the cited Kellis & Katis passage says. Names the fault without the number. Slow heel-to-glutes swings are clear.

R09.reason: -13 is right, but 'makes your shot go too high instead of staying low and powerful' is uncited causation (height and power). 'Pushed forward over your kicking foot' is a confusing instruction.

R10.reason: Power and accuracy claim is exactly K-09's; K-40 backs placement affecting speed; the drill is K-10. No number. Phantom kick beside the ball is concrete.

R11.reason: 'Makes your body lean away from the ball' contradicts this kick's trunk lean of +5.36 (forward); power claim uncited. Uses the number. Marker drill is concrete.

R12.reason: 'Bend was 101 degrees' is the same convention slip as R02, but 'which is too straight' fixes the direction. 'Stores energy' is loose shorthand for the cited stretch mechanism. Heel-close drill clear.

R13.reason: 'Knee bend ... was 98 deg' misdescribes the interior angle with nothing to correct it. Power claim backed by the cited source. 'Bend your knee more' and a slow backswing are vague.

R14.reason: Correct convention (94 deg between thigh and shin), compared with the studied players, mechanism attributed to the cited source. Wall leg swings with heel high are concrete.

R15.reason: Offset matches; 'hard to strike cleanly' has no source shown. Uses the number. 'Place your foot closer' gives no target.

R16.reason: Offset matches; the why is hedged as common coaching and uncited. Marker beside the ball, foot pointing at the target, is concrete.

R17.reason: Direction and number correct, but 'much more power' overstates what the cited source says. Heel high, then step and strike, is a clear sequence.

R18.reason: Stretch -> power is backed by K-35 and Kellis & Katis. No number. Heel-to-glutes before every kick is clear but loose.

R19.reason: K-09 backs the power claim; 'strike cleanly' is not in it. No number. Markers beside the ball are concrete.

R20.reason: -13 is right, but 'makes your shot rise too high and lose power' is two uncited causal claims. Slow-motion kicks keeping the upper body forward are usable but loose.
